description: Ritningssymboler för apparater m m plus beteckningar för andra apparater. The general symbol convention: a round symbol is used mostly where rotating parts occur; a rectangular symbol can be drawn upright or lying down and shows fixed parts.

entries.symbol_description: Circle or rectangle. The circle is used mostly where rotating parts occur; the rectangle (upright or lying) shows fixed parts.
Rectangle in the pipe run with an internal chevron/arrow.
Circle with an internal triangle pointing in the flow direction.
Rectangle with EXP written inside the symbol.
Small triangle on a vertical stem.
